{{recipesummary|category=Soup recipes|servings=6|time=½ hour|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] vegetable [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], in tiny cubes (the size of small peas)
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]]
* ½ cup diced yellow crooked-neck [[Cookbook:Squash|squash]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Corn|baby corn]], ¼-inch pieces (or ¼ cup frozen corn—see notes)
* ½ cup small [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]] (frozen—see notes)
* ½ cup minced firm [[Cookbook:Tofu|tofu]]
* 1–1½ cups cooked small [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]] (see notes)

==Procedure==

# Bring broth to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a medium-sized saucepan.
# Add carrots, and lower the heat to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]].
# Cook for 5 minutes, or until carrots are just tender.
# Add zucchini, squash, and corn.
# Simmer for 5 minutes, then stir in peas, tofu, and cooked pasta.
# Simmer just a couple of minutes longer.
# Serve hot (or very warm) in small bowl with small spoons.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Use small pasta (alphabets, little circles, little stars, and/or orzo) to delight kids!
* Cook pasta and store in water, covered, in the refrigerator until use. Drain well to add to the hot broth.
* Frozen vegetables can be added to the broth frozen.
